Name: Spheal in Stardew Valley (1.6)
Author: YumiSolarium
Description:
This mod add Spheal (the cutest pokemon ever, let's be real) as a farm animal living in the coop!

Spheals can be purchased from Marnie's shop, and they produce Spheal fur as well as pearls when they love you enough.

Spheal fur can be placed in a loom, and as for what it produce... I'll let you discover that yourself. :>

The mod come with a built-in french translation.

Downloads.Description: First version of the mod. Have fun!
